notes.title: UPDATE: 1.5.2 - Small Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello gamers! This update addresses a few small bugs that were mentioned in our community hub during this past week. Thank you to those who posted and let us know how our game can be improved.

 Patch Notes 
Fixes

 Level information screen now shows the proper "Bacteria Power Per Turn" as it was not being set correctly and always showed "100" (thanks for bringing this to our attention in the community hub!)
 We disabled the intro video so that you guys can get into the game even faster!


 If you find any issues or bugs, please do not hesitate to post in the forums and let us know immediately

notes.title: FREE CONTENT UPDATE V1.5!
notes.content:
We've received such positive feedback on this game, we've decided to release 5 bonus levels for FREE! We also added a number of other features you can see below:

V1.5 Patch Notes
Additions

 Added French language support
 Added German language support
 Added 5 Bonus Levels
 Added Linux support
 Added easter egg to main menu
 Added unique sound effect when obtaining an achievement

Fixes

 Fixed tutorial UI bouncing too much
 Fixed target reticle not showing the correct shape
 Fixed layout issues with various languages
 Fixed various issues related to focusing/unfocusing the game


If you find any issues or bugs, please do not hesitate to post in the forums and let us know immediately

notes.title: UPDATE: V1.4.2 - Addressing community feedback!
notes.content:
Greetings! This update addresses some bugs and issues that were mentioned in our community hub during this past week. Thank you to those who posted and let us know how our game can be improved.

Also, we have made progress on Linux support... so keep your eyes peeled for that big update coming soon!

 Patch Notes 
Fixes

 Game no longer auto-pauses when the app is unfocused (thanks for bringing this to our attention in the community hub!)
 You can no longer interact with the game while it is not the active application
 Updated Background Movement setting to also toggle bacteria eyes movement
 Fixed bug causing soft-lock when app is unfocused during grid generation
 QA for Linux completed

Known Bugs

 When the app regains focus, sometimes all the sfx played while the app was out of focus will play to catch up. If you plan on playing the game in windowed mode, and will be toggling between it and other apps, we recommend turning off sfx until we can resolve this bug
 Some minor visuals don't update correctly while the app is out of focus (they seem to fix themselves when you focus on the app)


 If you find any issues or bugs, please do not hesitate to post in the forums and let us know immediately

notes.title: UPDATE: V1.4.1 - Leaderboards Fixed!
notes.content:
Hello! This update is a very small, quick update to fix an important feature: Leaderboards. Now, when you look at a leaderboard, it will show you the top 50 entries on the list. We will look into adding a button that allows you to see the full leaderboard as well.

Also, we wanted to announce that Linux support is coming soon!

 Patch Notes 
 Fixes 

 Leaderboards now show 50 entries instead of 9
 When you open a leaderboard, if you are within the top 50 entries, the scroll view will try to scroll to your entry
 Leaderboards in-game have also been updated slightly

 Known bugs 

 The bacteria bonus stat shown in the level info panel seems to be stuck at 100
 Sometimes, when scrolling to your entry in the leaderboard view, it will not always scroll to the right location.


 If you find any issues or bugs, please do not hesitate to post in the forums and let us know immediately

notes.title: UPDATE: V1.4
notes.content:
Hello, we've got an update to address some bugs and issues found from our release build! Check out the patch notes below. You can make sure you're on the right version of the game by mousing over the 'FR' widget in the top left corner of the screen.

 Patch Notes 
 Fixes 

 Fixed bug causing leaderboard to disappear when beating a level and using quick restart
 Fixed bug causing end-level leaderboard appearing during game in 4:3 ratios
 Fixed bug causing invisible UI to block pause button in game
 Changed balance of Bulletproof Bugs: doses per turn is now 4, and bacteria bonus power is 40
 Improved spanish translations in a few spots
 Improved scaling of main menu ui elements for 4:3 aspect ratios

 Known bugs 

 The bacteria bonus stat shown in the level info panel seems to be stuck at 100
 The leaderboards appear to be capped at 10 entries... we will look into increasing that if possible.


 If you find any issues or bugs, please do not hesitate to post in the forums and let us know immediately

notes.title: OUT NOW: Containment!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31743256/daedac74139c20c59677e8986332362386456cc4.png
 Today is the day... 
We are incredibly excited to release our first game today. Containment will be going live at noon (EST), and we hope that you all enjoy this game. We've been working very hard to ensure that, in spite of it's short play time, the content is as polished and fun as possible.

 Problems? Talk to us! 
We care about our games, and we want to make sure you have a good experience playing them. If you're running into a problem, do not hesitate to post in the community hub or send us an email at info@finitereflection.com. We've listed a few bugs below that we are aware of, so please bear with us while we try to address them in an update soon.

 Release Notes 
 Known Bugs 

 Leaderboards don't update immediately. Steam is saving everyone's scores, but it takes a while for our UI to respond. Might be related to slow internet issues, so we are looking into a solution that saves scores locally for immediate viewing.
 Some resolutions result in weird visual bugs (stay away from 4:3 resolutions for now)
 Some of our Spanish translations may not be perfect, please let us know if anything is wrong and we will address it asap.

 Changelog 

 Fixed research UI disappearing beyond Beginner level
 Added localization for all tutorial pieces
 Finalized credits
 Fixed accents from rendering poorly (like "é")
 Research mechanic is hidden until the appropriate level


 Be sure to check out the message of the day and patch notes in-game!
